##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 21 September 2026 at 4:25pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure lies in the English Channel and over southern Britain.


##Wind##

South or Southwest 3 or 4.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, but risk of mist and fog patches.


##Visibility##

Good, falling poor or very poor in mist and fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or Southwest 3 or 4, veering North or Northwest later tomorrow night or at fist on Wednesday morning and increasing 5 to 7, then decreasing 4 or 5 later in the morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building moderate, possibly briefly moderate to rough in places.


##Weather##

Risk of mist patches, rain for a time, then fair later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor.
